paper.title: U-Net (Section 3): 572x572 tiles, batch 1, momentum 0.99, weighted CE, elastic deformation

note: The provided loop trains on synthetic touching cells; for the ISBI 2012 EM challenge and ISBI cell-tracking (PhC-U373, DIC-HeLa) datasets, plug `data.load_isbi2012` (or a cell-tracking loader) into train.run. The paper does not state the learning rate or iteration count; 0.01 / 10k are assumptions. Challenge metrics (warping/Rand/pixel error) are computed by the organisers' server.
